trace.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
trace.evidence: the set Hour of Devastation refers to set.name = 'Hour of Devastation'; names of all the cards in the set refers to cards.name; legal cards refers to status = 'Legal'; the formats refers to format

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
trace.answer: The Hour of Devastation cards are legal in many formats, including commander, duel, legacy, modern, pauper, penny, pioneer, and vintage. Examples include Act of Heroism, Adorned Pouncer, and Angel of Condemnation, each legal in commander, duel, legacy, modern, and penny (with more than 1,000 name-format pairs in total).
